body:
## Summary

`gdoc edit` and `gdoc suggest` previously searched and replaced text only in the document body. Anchors that lived in a header, footer, or footnote reported "no match", even though the Docs API exposes those segments alongside the body.

This PR makes text replacement work across all of a tab's independent index spaces:

- `find_text_in_document` now searches the selected tab's body, then its headers, footers, and footnotes (sorted by segment ID so write order is deterministic). Matches outside the body carry `container` and `segmentId`, plus `tabId` when a tab was supplied. Passing `body=` explicitly keeps the legacy body-only behavior and range shape.
- `flatten_tabs` now carries `headers`, `footers`, and `footnotes` through from each tab's `documentTab`, so tabbed documents expose the same segments as legacy ones.
- When a legacy (non-tab) read finds header/footer/footnote content, `_prepare_text_replacement` in the CLI re-fetches the document with tabs and pins the first tab, so non-body ranges always carry explicit tab coordinates and the revision ID matches the content that was searched.
- `_build_replacement_requests` orders matches per index space (body, header, footer, footnote; descending `startIndex` within each) and stamps `segmentId` on every delete/insert request that targets a non-body segment. Overlap detection compares matches only within the same tab and segment.
- Non-body replacements are restricted to a single plain or inline-Markdown paragraph. Headings, lists, tables, code fences, paragraph breaks, and multi-paragraph replacements in a header, footer, or footnote raise a usage error (exit 3) instead of producing malformed requests. Body replacements are unchanged; heading cleanup and table insertion still run for body matches only.
- Tests cover matching, replacement ordering, request `segmentId` stamping, default-tab addressing, the inline-only and block-boundary guards, and the suggest path across segments.

One commit also clears pre-existing Ruff violations (import order, line wrapping, unused bindings) across `gdoc/` and `tests/` so `uv run ruff check gdoc/ tests/` passes cleanly. Runtime strings and request payloads are unchanged by that commit.

Local checks: `uv run ruff check gdoc/ tests/`, `uv run pytest tests/` (1608 passed), `bash scripts/check-no-stubs.sh`. Verified live against a throwaway doc: replacements in body, header, and footnote landed with sibling and segment styles unchanged.
title: fix: replace text in headers, footers, and footnotes
